verdict.rationale: Shortwave is a SaaS email client, so issuing scoped API credentials to external agents is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of API keys, tokens, or permission scoping. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Its MCP 'Add custom integration' feature is client-side: it connects Shortwave's own assistant out to other servers rather than issuing credentials to agents, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
